```{r}
library("robis")
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2")
library("lubridate")
library("stringr")
library("dplyr")
library("sf")
library("here")

```

```{r}
# Fetch all occurrences of Green Sea Turtles
turtles_raw <- robis::occurrence(
  scientificname = "Chelonia mydas",
  startdate = "2015-01-01",
  enddate = "2025-12-31",
  fields = c("occurrenceID", "scientificName", "decimalLatitude", 
             "decimalLongitude", "individualCount", "eventDate")
)

# Convert the download into a spatial (sf) object using standard coordinates (WGS84)
turtles_sf <- turtles_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(decimalLongitude) & !is.na(decimalLatitude)) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4326)



```

```{r}
# Tell GDAL to automatically rebuild the missing .shx file
sf::sf_extSoftVersion()["GDAL"] # (Optional: just to confirm sf is using GDAL)
Sys.setenv(SHAPE_RESTORE_SHX = "YES")

# read shapefile and convert coordinate system to (WGS 84)
gbr_mpa <- sf::st_read("C:/Users/nrmou/OneDrive/Documents/TechniquesMS/Nudi/data/GBR_MPA.shp")

st_crs(gbr_mpa) <- 4326

```

```{r}
#check both coordinate reference systems
st_crs(turtles_sf)

st_crs(gbr_mpa)
```

```{r}
# Extract records that fall within the MPA boundaries
turtles_in_mpas <- st_intersection(turtles_sf, gbr_mpa)

```

```{r}
# Filter for records that contain explicit abundance numbers
abundance_records <- turtles_in_mpas %>%
  filter(!is.na(individualCount) & individualCount > 0) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% # Convert from spatial back to regular dataframe for easy viewing
  select(scientificName, eventDate, individualCount) 
  # Note: Change 'NAME' to match the column designation for names inside your MPA shapefile

# View the final dataset
print(abundance_records)

```


```{r}
```

```{r}
# 1. Sort the data so smaller counts are plotted first, and larger counts are plotted on top
# Convert the column to numeric first
turtles_in_mpas <- turtles_in_mpas %>%
  mutate(individualCount = as.numeric(individualCount))


# 2. Plot the data
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = gbr_mpa, fill = "lightblue", color = "black") + # MPA boundaries
  geom_sf(data = turtles_in_mpas, aes(size = individualCount), color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.6) + # Turtle occurrences
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Individual Count", range = c(1, 10)) + # Fix: Changed to continuous
  labs(title = "Green Sea Turtle Occurrences within the GBR Marine Park", 
       subtitle = "2015-2025", 
       x = "Longitude", 
       y = "Latitude") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")


```

```{r}
ggsave("C:/Users/nrmou/OneDrive/Documents/TechniquesMS/Nudi/output/turtle_GBR.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#new graph with more color and better legend
ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(
    data = gbr_mpa,
    fill = "lightblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = turtles_in_mpas,
    aes(
      size = individualCount,
      color = individualCount
    ),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Individual Count",
    range = c(1, 10)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name = "Turtle Abundance",
    colours = c("yellow", "orange", "red", "darkred")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Green Sea Turtle Occurrences within the GBR Marine Park",
    subtitle = "2015-2025",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
